title_en: The covenants—“How God Will Accomplish His Purpose”
description_en: The Watchtower of October 15, 2014, presents a chart of the Edenic promise and the six covenants that advance God’s purpose by means of the Messianic Kingdom: the Abrahamic covenant, the Law covenant, the Davidic covenant, the covenant for a priest like Melchizedek, the new covenant, and the Kingdom covenant. Each group gives the parties and purpose exactly as the chart prints them, with when the covenant was made, took effect, or ended taken from the two articles, Insight “Covenant,” and The Watchtower of July 2020. Other covenants listed in Insight (with Noah, the rainbow covenant, circumcision, Levi, and Moab) follow.
description_ta: கடவுள் தம்முடைய விருப்பத்தை நிறைவேற்ற ஓர் அரசாங்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்துவார் என்பதை ஏதேனில் அவர் கொடுத்த வாக்குறுதி தெளிவாகக் காட்டுகிறது. அந்த அரசாங்கத்தைப் பற்றி கடவுள் படிப்படியாக ஆறு ஒப்பந்தங்கள் மூலம் விளக்கினார்.

sources.title_en: Have Unshakable Faith in the Kingdom
sources.par: chart “How God Will Accomplish His Purpose”
sources.quote_en: The Edenic promise points to the Kingdom as the means by which God’s original purpose for the earth and mankind will be fulfilled. The following six covenants advance the outworking of God’s purpose:

sources.title_en: Have Unshakable Faith in the Kingdom
sources.quote_en: They are (1) the Abrahamic covenant, (2) the Law covenant, (3) the Davidic covenant, (4) the covenant for a priest like Melchizedek, (5) the new covenant, and (6) the Kingdom covenant.

sources.title_en: You Will Become “a Kingdom of Priests”
sources.quote_en: All the covenants that we have considered in these two articles relate to one or more vital aspects of the Kingdom. (See the chart “How God Will Accomplish His Purpose” in the previous article.)
The rainbow covenant was made between Jehovah God and all flesh (human and animal), as represented by Noah and his family, in 2369 B.C.E., in the mountains of Ararat.
validation and inauguration of new covenant: w20.07 31 … two covenants (Ga 4:24) were Law covenant and Abrahamic covenant: w26.06 31
There is no distinction between when the new covenant was validated and when it was inaugurated.

attributes.chart: The Edenic promise points to the Kingdom as the means by which God’s original purpose for the earth and mankind will be fulfilled.
attributes.chart_ta: கடவுள் தம்முடைய விருப்பத்தை நிறைவேற்ற ஓர் அரசாங்கத்தை ஏற்படுத்துவார் என்பதை ஏதேனில் அவர் கொடுத்த வாக்குறுதி தெளிவாகக் காட்டுகிறது.
attributes.stated (Insight): in the garden of Eden in the presence of Adam, Eve, and the “serpent”

groups.note: Heads the chart; the chart then lists the six covenants. Parties and purpose are not printed for the Edenic promise.

attributes.purpose: It forms a legal basis for the “offspring” of “the woman” of Genesis 3:15 to rule in the Kingdom
attributes.purpose_ta: ஆதியாகமம் 3:15-ல் சொல்லப்பட்ட ‘பெண்ணின்’ ‘வாரிசுக்கு’ ஆட்சி செய்யும் உரிமை இருக்கிறது என்பதைக் காட்டுவதற்காகச் செய்யப்பட்டது

attributes.went into effect (w14 10/15 pp. 7-12 par: 1943 B.C.E., when 75-year-old Abraham left Haran and crossed the Euphrates River
attributes.duration (w14 10/15 pp. 7-12 par. 12): “an everlasting covenant” (Gen. 17:7); it remains in effect until the Messianic Kingdom destroys God’s enemies and all the families of the earth have been blessed

groups.note: Parties and purpose as printed in the chart; dates and duration from the article text and Insight “Covenant”.

attributes.purpose: It protects the “offspring” and leads humans to the Messiah
attributes.made (Insight): in the third month after their leaving Egypt, in 1513 B.C.E. (Ex. 19:1)
attributes.ended (w14 10/15 pp. 13-17 par. 11): made in a sense “obsolete” when Jehovah announced the new covenant through Jeremiah, but it did not actually end until the new covenant went into effect
attributes.ended (Insight): In 33 C.E. the Law covenant was canceled on the basis of Christ’s death on the torture stake (Col. 2:14), the new covenant replacing it

groups.note: Parties and purpose as printed in the chart.

attributes.purpose: It establishes that the Messianic King will come from David’s line and that what the Kingdom accomplishes will be everlasting
attributes.purpose_ta: கடவுளுடைய அரசாங்கத்தின் ராஜா, தாவீதின் சந்ததியில்தான் வருவார் என்பதையும், அவருடைய ஆட்சியில் கிடைக்கும் ஆசீர்வாதங்கள் என்றென்றும் நிலைத்திருக்கும் என்பதையும் தெரியப்படுத்துவதற்காகச் செய்யப்பட்டது
attributes.when made (Insight): at some time during David’s reign in Jerusalem (1070-1038 B.C.E.)

groups.note: Parties and purpose as printed in the chart.

groups.label_en: Covenant for a priest like Melchizedek

attributes.purpose: It provides a legal arrangement for Jesus​—the primary part of the woman’s “offspring”—​to be king and priest forever
attributes.purpose_ta: இயேசு மெல்கிசேதேக்கைப் போல் ராஜாவாகவும் தலைமை குருவாகவும் இருப்பதற்காகச் செய்யப்பட்டது

attributes.High Priest from (w20.07 p. 31): Jesus became High Priest when he got baptized in 29 C.E.
attributes.duration (w14 10/15 pp. 7-12 par. 17; In: “a priest forever in the manner of Melchizedek” (Heb. 5:4-6; 7:3)

attributes.purpose: It provides a legal basis for 144,000 Christians to be adopted as sons of God and to form the secondary part of the “offspring”
attributes.purpose_ta: இயேசுவோடு சேர்ந்து ஆட்சி செய்யப்போகும் 1,44,000 பேரும் கடவுளுடைய மகன்களாக தத்தெடுக்கப்படுவதற்கும் ‘கிறிஸ்துவின் சக வாரிசுகளாக’ ஆவதற்கும் செய்யப்பட்டது

members.label_en: On the day of Pentecost he inaugurated this covenant toward them by the anointing with holy spirit

notes: On WOL the chart “How God Will Accomplish His Purpose” (w14 10/15 pp. 7-12; in Tamil the box “ஒப்பந்தங்கள்” on p. 12) is text, not an image: it prints PARTIES and PURPOSE for each covenant; the only picture in it is the illustration recorded under images. Dates and durations in the group attributes are labelled with their source. Where the 2014 articles and Insight (1988) differ, the newer wording is used for roles and the older one is kept in attributes/notes (Law covenant’s end; when the new covenant was validated, clarified in w20.07 p. 31). Members shared between groups (b3-0088, b5-0152, b5-0163, b5-0169, b6-0001) appear once per group.
